features: Immediate source presentation with bounded motion prediction; delayed native FSR remains selectable
Single dense block-selection table for Create/Flywheel models, visual updates, factory details and client tick policies
Registry-discovered all/whitelist/blacklist block selector with ID/name search
Full visualization-context instance ownership, including embeddings and transferred/late-created instances
Unified distant visual update policy and concise Russian/English descriptions
limitations: Prediction is not native FSR interpolation; abrupt motion and disocclusion can produce artifacts
Shared GPU, capture and presentation/VSync overhead can still add latency
Selection does not remove static chunk geometry or entity visuals; custom time-driven shaders need separate support
Visibility restoration is budgeted and can take multiple frames
Final aimed-target full-hide/freeze guard was compiled/unit-tested but not separately game-tested
